rigidProjectionGate: DQS variant2 explicitly projects near-rigid matrices to unit quaternion+original translation. Every positive-support seam/bone point must move <=10um world from original matrix; orthogonality guard2e-4/determinant positive. Does not alter source bones or curves. Variant1 exact-near-rigidity1e-5 gate rejected and retained.
normalConvention: Linear blended bone normal; normalize. Linear blended tangent; Gram-Schmidt to normal; preserve source tangent.w. Not corrective geometry or a proof of surface derivative normals.
